title: Characterization of weights for the variable fractional maximal operator and weighted inequalities for variable fractional rough operators
summary: We characterize the class of weights related to the boundedness of variable fractional maximal operator $M_{β(\cdot),r(\cdot)}$ on variable Lebesgue spaces. This extend previously known results, including those corresponding to the fractional operator $M_{β(\cdot),1}$. In addition, we introduce a class of kernels $K$ satisfying a new variable Hörmander-type condition $H_{β(\cdot),r(\cdot)}$. For the fractional operator $T_{β(\cdot)}$ given by a kernel in $H_{β(\cdot),r(\cdot)}$, we prove a Coifman-Fefferman inequality and weighted inequalities in variable Lebesgue space.
